Writ Petition No. 12668 Of 2023
 Uttam Anandrao Bhosale & Anr 
 Versus
 Special Land Acquisition Officer No.11 Collector
 Officer & Ors 
 Mr. Yuvraj Narvankar, Advocate for the Petitioners.
 Ms. Nisha Mehra, Agp, for Respondent-State.

Coram : B. P. Colabawalla &
 Somasekhar Sundaresan, Jj.

Date : December 11, 2023
 Pc :
1.
Not on board.
At the request of the Petitioners, taken on board.
2. The above Writ Petition is filed inter alia

seeking a declaration that retention of an amount towards nazarana is illegal and bad in law and non est, and a direction to Respondent No. 1 to release the entire amount of compensation in favour of the Petitioners.
The above Writ Petition is coming up for the first time.
Digitally signed by ASHWINI ASHWINI JANARDAN JANARDAN VALLAKATI VALLAKATI
